# splunkctl kvstore

KV store — collections and document CRUD (allowlists, threat intel).

## kvstore collections

List KV store collection names in an app.

```text
splunkctl kvstore collections [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore create

Create a new, empty KV store collection.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl kvstore create [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore delete

Delete a KV store collection — removes the collection and ALL its data.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl kvstore delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore export

Export all documents in a collection as JSONL (one doc per line).

```text
splunkctl kvstore export [OPTIONS] COLLECTION
```

```text
Writes to stdout, or to the file given by the global ``--out``/``-o``
flag. ``_key`` is preserved on every document, so ``kvstore import``
can upsert straight back onto the same keys.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore import

Bulk-upsert documents from a JSONL file via batch_save.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl kvstore import [OPTIONS] COLLECTION
```

```text
A document whose ``_key`` already exists in the collection is
upserted (overwritten) — that's ``batch_save``'s own semantics, not
special-cased here. POSTs in chunks of up to 500 documents.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--file` | file | - | JSONL file: one JSON document per line. [required] |
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore insert

Insert one document into a collection (exactly one of --data/--file).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl kvstore insert [OPTIONS] COLLECTION
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data` | text | - | Single JSON document. |
| `--file` | file | - | Read the JSON document from a file. |
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore query

Query documents in a collection.

```text
splunkctl kvstore query [OPTIONS] COLLECTION
```

```text
``--query``/``--limit``/``--skip``/``--sort`` map straight to the
KV store data API's own params — filtering and paging happen
server-side, never re-applied client-side.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--query` | text | - | Raw JSON filter, passed through unmodified to the API's 'query' param. |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Max documents to return. |
| `--skip` | integer range | - | Skip the first N documents. |
| `--sort` | text | - | Sort spec, e.g. 'field1,-field2'. |
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore remove

Remove one document by _key, or many by --query (exactly one required).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl kvstore remove [OPTIONS] COLLECTION [KEY]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--query` | text | - | Delete-by-query JSON (mutually exclusive with KEY). |
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |

## kvstore update

Replace one document by _key (exactly one of --data/--file).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl kvstore update [OPTIONS] COLLECTION KEY
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data` | text | - | Single JSON document. |
| `--file` | file | - | Read the JSON document from a file. |
| `--app` | text | search | Splunk app context (default: search). |
